aboutMe: I've been working in the software development sector since 2018 as an experienced full-stack engineer specializing in .Net & React. It offers me great satisfaction to work on my code until it works properly, even if it means working for 24 hours straight. My ultimate objective is to use my expertise to build solutions that make the world a better place. I am also a co-founder and admin of the BCA-TU Facebook community where BCA students can get peer support. I take great delight in passing on my knowledge and skills to beginners in the profession. Simultaneously, I am constantly willing to learn from others and improve my abilities. I also value developing solid relationships with people in the same field so we can assist each other. It brings me great joy to discover the knowledge I shared helped someone. I love discovering the potential of technology through experiments and gradual challenges that extend my knowledge level.

keypoints.title: Salary Expectation
keypoints.value: Nrs 250K - 300K (Flexible based on other benefits and work culture)

additionalInformation: Apart from my 9-5 job as a software developer, I enjoy contributing to open-source projects, writing technical reports, and mentoring junior developers. In my free time, I like to explore new technologies, reinvent something to understand it better. I also love spending time in nature, hiking, and exploring which helps me to relax and refresh my mind.
